question: The BrahMos supersonic cruise missile, with increased indigenous content and improved performance, was successfully test-fired from the Integrated Test Range in _______ off the coast of Odisha at 1030 hours on 20 January 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandipur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BrahMos supersonic cruise missile**, which is a joint venture between **India and Russia,** was successfully test-fired from the Integrated Test Range in **Chandipur **off the coast of **Odisha **at 1030 hours on **20 January 2022**.
 
• The missile has been developed with **increased indigenous content**, which means that more components of the missile are being manufactured within the country, reducing the need for** imports **and making it more self-reliant.
 
• The improved performance of the missile is a result of upgrades in its **range and accuracy, **making it a **formidable weapon** for the Indian military.
 
• The Integrated Test Range in Chandipur is a premier missile testing facility in India, where various missiles, including the **Agni and Prithvi series,** have been tested in the past.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gopalpur-on-sea **is a coastal town in the **Ganjam district** of** Odisha, **known for its beautiful beaches and resorts.
 
• **Paradip** is a **major port town** in Odisha, which handles a large volume of cargo, including **iron ore, coal, and petroleum **products.
 
• **Puri** is a popular tourist destination in Odisha, known for its ancient** temples, beaches, and cultural heritage**.
 
• It is also home to the famous **Jagannath Temple, **which attracts millions of devotees every year.
